qts.CALENDAR_NAME qts_CALENDAR_NAME, qts.DESCRIPTION qts_DESCRIPTION, qts.END_TIME qts_END_TIME, qts.JOB_GROUP qts_JOB_GROUP, qts.JOB_NAME qts_JOB_NAME, qts.MISFIRE_INSTR qts_MISFIRE_INSTR, qts.NEXT_FIRE_TIME qts_NEXT_FIRE_TIME, qts.PREV_FIRE_TIME qts_PREV_FIRE_TIME, qts.PRIORITY qts_PRIORITY, qts.SCHED_NAME qts_SCHED_NAME, qts.START_TIME qts_START_TIME, qts.TRIGGER_GROUP qts_TRIGGER_GROUP, qts.TRIGGER_NAME qts_TRIGGER_NAME, qts.TRIGGER_STATE qts_TRIGGER_STATE, qts.TRIGGER_TYPE qts_TRIGGER_TYPE
mapper.select: select a.END_TIME, a.JOB_GROUP, a.JOB_NAME, a.NEXT_FIRE_TIME, a.PREV_FIRE_TIME, a.SCHED_NAME , a.START_TIME, a.TRIGGER_STATE, a.TRIGGER_TYPE, qjd.DESCRIPTION, qct.CRON_EXPRESSION,qjd.JOB_DATA,if(qjd.IS_NONCONCURRENT='1',false, true) IS_NONCONCURRENT from qrtz_triggers a left join qrtz_job_details qjd on a.SCHED_NAME = qjd.SCHED_NAME and a.JOB_NAME = qjd.JOB_NAME and a.JOB_GROUP = qjd.JOB_GROUP left join qrtz_cron_triggers qct on a.SCHED_NAME = qct.SCHED_NAME and a.TRIGGER_NAME = qct.TRIGGER_NAME and a.TRIGGER_GROUP = qct.TRIGGER_GROUP where qct.CRON_EXPRESSION is not null and qct.CRON_EXPRESSION != ''

select a.END_TIME, a.JOB_GROUP, a.JOB_NAME, a.NEXT_FIRE_TIME, a.PREV_FIRE_TIME, a.SCHED_NAME , a.START_TIME, a.TRIGGER_STATE, a.TRIGGER_TYPE, qjd.DESCRIPTION, qct.CRON_EXPRESSION,qjd.JOB_DATA,if(qjd.IS_NONCONCURRENT='1',false, true) IS_NONCONCURRENT from qrtz_triggers a left join qrtz_job_details qjd on a.SCHED_NAME = qjd.SCHED_NAME and a.JOB_NAME = qjd.JOB_NAME and a.JOB_GROUP = qjd.JOB_GROUP left join qrtz_cron_triggers qct on a.SCHED_NAME = qct.SCHED_NAME and a.TRIGGER_NAME = qct.TRIGGER_NAME and a.TRIGGER_GROUP = qct.TRIGGER_GROUP where a.SCHED_NAME=#{schedName} AND a.JOB_NAME=#{jobName}
